declined.subject: repository-landing-document
declined.reason: The subject 'repository-landing-document' governs a code repository's root front page (README.md) and code host metadata (description, topics, homepage). The standard explicitly excludes application-rendered UI surfaces, assigning them to 'public-claim-provenance' (§ Where this subject's walls sit). 'landing-core' is an application web UI orchestrator (features/landing/LandingPage.tsx) rendering live CivicScore standings, hemicycle visualization, and data source status, not a repository front page.

declined.subject: repository-landing-document
declined.reason: The subject 'repository-landing-document' governs a repository's root front page (README.md) and host metadata on a code host. 'app-shell' provides the Next.js App Router root layout (app/layout.tsx), global CSS tokens (app/globals.css), error boundaries, and static legal pages for the web application. It contains no repository landing document or repository host metadata.
